title: Owner Service Terms: Election of Reduced Paid-Up Insurance on Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — premium-paying Ashgrove policies.

## Terms of the election

An owner of a premium-paying policy may stop premiums and continue it as reduced paid-up insurance by signed election, effective on the paid-to date; the reduced paid-up face is bought by the net cash value at the net single premium per 1,000 of paid-up insurance from the most recent anniversary statement and must be at least the tier's smallest reduced paid-up face.

## When the reduced paid-up face is fixed

The reduced paid-up face is fixed only after the loan balance shown on the policy stands at zero with a loan offset entry for it on the policy ledger.

The reduced paid-up face is not worked out until the dividend accumulation balance shown on the policy stands at zero with an accumulation withdrawal entry for the election on the policy ledger.

Read together: while the policy record still shows a loan balance with no loan offset entry for it on the ledger, or still shows a dividend accumulation balance with no accumulation withdrawal entry for the election on the ledger, there is no fixed reduced paid-up face.

| Element | Effect of the election |
|---|---|
| Who elects | The owner, by signed election |
| Effective date | The paid-to date |
| Status afterwards | Reduced paid-up; no further premium is billed |
| Face afterwards | The reduced paid-up face |

## Owner's election tool: `elect_reduced_paid_up_64725b60`

**Capability.** Records the policy owner's own election to stop paying premiums on their Ashgrove whole life policy and keep it as reduced paid-up insurance. It changes the policy from premium-paying to reduced paid-up status, sets the policy's face amount to the reduced paid-up face given, records reduced paid-up as the nonforfeiture option in effect and records the effective date of the election.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hand it over; the customer themselves — the owner — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the owner's whole life policy being converted to reduced paid-up insurance, which the agent reads to the owner from the whole life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `effective_date` | The date the reduced paid-up insurance takes effect | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `reduced_face_amount` | The face amount of the reduced paid-up insurance | US dollars with 2 decimal places; a whole-dollar face is written with .00 |

**Return.** A receipt with `election_id` (the reference of the recorded election), `whole_policy_id`, `status` (`reduced_paid_up` once recorded), `reduced_face_amount` (2 decimal places) and `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying an `election_id` and status `reduced_paid_up` means the election took effect.
